items.step: Wave 1: implement frame/value foundation, canonical codecs, fingerprints, value policy, and conformance vectors
Wave 2: implement Timeline, TranscriptImage, replay cursor, and pointer-free image encoding
Wave 3: refactor Machine to frame-first nextFrame/resumeFrame plus Native/Replay/Verify adapters
Wave 4: implement image-backed replay, checkpoint, branch, and audit image semantics
Wave 5: add frame/timeline/byte/agent examples, docs, build steps, and hot-path guards
Wave 6: run fixed-point review, full Zig proof bundle, and ship PR
